== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Phylo Gandish (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1263_26</code>, Virtual Block 6.3 slip 3•25), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. Lore line breaks as on the PC card image.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p847474 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 30 October 2013: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p847474 (the post writes the pilot clause “[P]2.”)
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. If opponent's [Virtual Block 6] or [Virtual Block 4] card just added a destiny to total power or attrition here (except battle destiny), draw two destiny, choose one, and subtract it from their attrition and total power. Your characters here are immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 3.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-25-Phylo_Gandish-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
